annotations.text:
SEPTEMBER 2026 · three @_jiing carousels, one per row. copy is final from the september slate; numbers are sourced on the last slide of each set.
row 1: the condo has to qualify too (post first)
row 2: van nuys is getting a train (jen's take is a draft of hers)
row 3: the insurance quote comes before the offer
export each slide as its own PNG (Export in the toolbar), 1080x1350.

THREE DIRECTIONS on the condo set (cover, slide 3, slide 4, close). same copy, three skins. photos are real and cleared (CC0 / public domain); swap in jen's own shots anywhere.
A photo editorial: the current system + full-bleed place photography. least change, most trust. tradeoff: still the same cream/navy column at a glance.
B field notes: paper, tilted prints, tape, handwriting, red pencil. reads like her notes from a showing. tradeoff: the loudest departure from the polished grid; needs discipline to not go cute.
C color block: one bold colour per series (terracotta here; moss for the rail set, ochre for insurance) + duotone photos + huge numerals. tradeoff: colour must rotate per set or it becomes its own beige.

A · photo editorial
motivation: instagram rewards a real place in frame; the system stays hers.
risk: reads like a listing account if every cover is a building.

B · field notes
motivation: unmistakable in a feed of clean templates; matches 'the friend who happens to sell real estate'.
risk: handwriting and tape can tip into scrapbook if overused. two annotations max per slide.

C · color block
motivation: each series gets a colour, so three carousels in a row read as three different posts.
risk: terracotta is a departure from her navy/cream brand; keep navy as the ink so it still reads as jen.
